viewing_check: Estimate A$40-70, current bid A$15 plus 22%. Nothing here meets the 'first worth hundreds' rule on what is visible. At viewing, flip through the stack for anything not photographed. Specifically check (1) the Gold Key Star Treks: read the issue number and code top-left; only #1-10 (1967-71, codes 10210-...) are worth hundreds, and 1975 issues are not; (2) any Simpsons Comics #1 (Bongo 1993) or Bart Simpson #1; (3) anything pre-1970 (10c/12c US, or Australian K.G. Murray/Colour Comics 1950s-60s, which can be A$20-100+ each); (4) condition: spines, stains, missing covers. Otherwise it is a cheap reader lot worth no more than about A$50 all-in.
